title: Home practical guide and safety card: muffling test
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Sound (Misty Mountain, Sierra and How Can We Change a Sound?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 16 (Home practical guide and safety card: muffling test (portal worksheet; alarm on low, never near the ear))
intro: Lesson 16: Muffling sound: which material blocks it best?. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which material blocks sound best
equipment: A phone or clock alarm on a low volume
Materials to test: tea towel, foil, bubble wrap, a jumper
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Set the alarm on low; never hold it near your ear
Put the alarm in the box with nothing round it and stand 2 m away
Wrap it in one material and listen from the same place
Repeat with each material, the same thickness each time
Score each one: 3 loud, 2 quiet, 1 can hardly hear, 0 silent

questions.q: Big question: why does an empty room sound echoey?
questions.a: Hard walls reflect sound; there is nothing soft to absorb it.
